name: Spectrometer (Optical Emission)
measurement: Chemical Analysis of Alloys & Trace Elements
description: High-precision optical emission spectrometer used for rapid, multi-element quantitative chemical analysis to verify strict metallurgical standards before casting and shipping.

name: Vacuum Analysis System
description: Measures dissolved hydrogen gas levels in liquid aluminum melts to prevent gas porosity and ensure superior mechanical properties of the end products.

name: Pin Hole Analysis
description: Evaluates specimen solidification and porosity levels to confirm optimal alloy density and sound internal crystal structure.

name: Densitometer Analysis
description: Accurately determines specific gravity and density of auxiliary consumables and process fluids to maintain strict operational controls.

name: Viscosity Meter Analysis
description: Monitors fluid viscosity of industrial oils, lubricants, and fuel products ensuring optimal furnace operation and thermal efficiency.

name: Hydrometer
description: Reliable testing instrument for rapid verification of liquid density and purity across raw materials and testing chemicals.
